hook: OpenAI reveals the perplexity numbers behind its models

beats.say: OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki says held-out perplexity has been the company's constant measure of pretraining progress, and he published its internal numbers.
GPT-3.5 sat at a log-perplexity of about 0.99 and GPT-4 at about 0.91. Below 0.8, strong cybersecurity and math abilities appeared, and a model near 0.76 started producing breakthrough math results.
He expects new capabilities around 0.68 to 0.7, and proposes shared, perplexity-based limits that labs agree not to cross until monitoring catches up.
